articles.title: “Ghat Road Horror!” 9 Kerala Tourists, Including Teachers, Killed as Van Plunges into Gorge
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Coimbatore: In a tragic road accident on April 17, 2026, nine tourists from Kerala, including six school staff members, lost their lives after their van veered off the Valparai–Pollachi Ghat Road and plunged into a deep gorge on Friday evening.

body.html:
Coimbatore: In a tragic road accident on April 17, 2026, nine tourists from Kerala, including six school staff members, lost their lives after their van veered off the Valparai–Pollachi Ghat Road and plunged into a deep gorge on Friday evening.

The accident occurred around 5:15 pm at the 13th hairpin bend under Kadamparai police station limits. The victims were part of a 13-member tourist group from Perinthalmanna in Malappuram district, returning from a sightseeing trip to Valparai.

According to preliminary reports, the driver lost control of the vehicle while negotiating a sharp curve. The van skidded off the road and rolled down several hundred feet through dense terrain before coming to rest near the ninth hairpin bend.

Nine passengers died on the spot. The deceased have been identified as Ajitha (54), Ramla (52), Suhara (43), Asha (41), Majeeth (43), Sajitha (45), Shakeela (37), Ruqiya (39), and Hisham (12).

Among them, Ajitha was the headteacher of Government LP School, Palliparambu, while Ramla, Suhara, Asha, and Majeeth were also teachers at the same school. Shakeela was a teacher at Government Upper Primary School, Pang. Sajitha worked as school support staff, while Ruqiya was Majeeth’s wife and Hisham was Suhara’s son.

Four others, including the driver, sustained serious injuries and were rushed to hospital.

Police and fire and rescue teams reached the spot soon after receiving information and launched a challenging rescue operation due to the steep terrain. All survivors were safely evacuated from the mangled vehicle.

The bodies have been sent for postmortem, and a case has been registered by Kadamparai police. An investigation is underway to ascertain the exact cause of the accident.

Coimbatore District Collector Pavankumar G Giriyappanavar visited the site and reviewed the rescue efforts.

The incident has cast a pall of gloom over the victims’ hometown in Kerala.

articles.title: “Reel Gone Wrong!” 3 Youths Die Filming Stunt on Highway in MP, Accident Caught on Camera
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Mauganj: A tragic accident in Madhya Pradesh’s Mauganj district claimed the lives of three youths who were allegedly filming a social media reel while riding a high-speed motorcycle. The incident occurred on the Panni-Patharia National Highway under Laur police station limits.

body.html:
Mauganj: A tragic accident in Madhya Pradesh’s Mauganj district claimed the lives of three youths who were allegedly filming a social media reel while riding a high-speed motorcycle. The incident occurred on the Panni-Patharia National Highway under Laur police station limits.

The deceased have been identified as Uplaksh alias Shubham Kol (18), Amrish Kol (22), and Hemraj Kol (18), all residents of Bela police station area. Two others — Prashant Dwivedi (19) and Pradeep Dwivedi (18), residents of Chitaipurwa Pipra — sustained serious injuries.

According to police, the group was riding two motorcycles, with one bike filming the other. In the viral video, three youths on a Pulsar 220 can be seen riding at high speed, performing risky stunts and repeatedly overtaking trucks.

One of the youth is seen posing for the camera while another brandishes a pistol-like lighter, indicating their focus was on filming rather than road safety.

Within seconds, the situation turned fatal. While attempting to overtake another truck, the speeding bike lost balance and collided directly with the vehicle. The impact threw all three riders onto the road, killing them on the spot.

Moments later, the second motorcycle coming from behind also crashed into the same truck, leaving its two riders seriously injured.

Police said the entire incident unfolded within seconds, leaving no time for reaction. The injured were rushed to hospital for treatment.

Laur police station in-charge Reena Singh confirmed that the bodies were sent for postmortem and a lighter gun was recovered from the spot. The trailer truck involved in the accident has been seized.

Preliminary investigation suggests the motorcycle was travelling at a speed of around 100–120 km/h.

The incident highlights the dangers of reckless driving and the growing trend of risky stunt videos for social media.

#MadhyaPradesh #Mauganj #RoadAccident #ReelGoneWrong #ViralVideo

articles.title: Honeytrap Gang Leader, Arrested for Raping Minor Boy in Nainital & Blackmailing Family for ₹25 Lakh
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Lucknow: Police in Lucknow, the capital of Uttar Pradesh, arrested Atika Siddiqui on Saturday, 18 April 2026, for allegedly raping a 16-year-old boy, making obscene videos of him, and extorting ₹25 lakh from his family through blackmail.

body.html:
Lucknow: Police in Lucknow, the capital of Uttar Pradesh, arrested Atika Siddiqui on Saturday, 18 April 2026, for allegedly raping a 16-year-old boy, making obscene videos of him, and extorting ₹25 lakh from his family through blackmail. She is said to be the kingpin of a honeytrap gang targeting young Hindu men and teenagers.

The incident came to light when the minor from Thakurganj area went missing on 17 February 2026. His family discovered that Atika, the elder sister-in-law of the boy's friend, had lured him and taken him to Nainital in Uttarakhand. There, she allegedly forced him into physical relations for several days and recorded nude and obscene videos.

Upon returning, the boy became unusually quiet and withdrawn. Atika then sent the videos to his family, demanding ₹25 lakh ransom and threatening to make them viral on social media. The family, under severe stress, approached Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath for help and filed an FIR eight days ago.

Before her arrest, Atika tried to counter the case by filing a false complaint alleging that the minor boy, a journalist, and two others had gang-raped her. Police investigation found her claims false, and a video evidence surfaced showing her demanding the ransom.

Atika has been charged under relevant sections of the Indian Penal Code for kidnapping, rape, and extortion, along with provisions of the POCSO Act, as the victim is a minor. She has been sent to judicial custody. Police are probing if she was part of a larger gang running this honeytrap racket in the Thakurganj area.

articles.title: “Ex-Minister’s Son Held, Gets Quick Bail?” Molestation Case in Muzaffarnagar Raises Questions
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Muzaffarnagar: Aryaman Raghuvanshi (28), son of former state minister Sudhir Kumar Baliyan, and his accomplice Shaurya Gupta (18) were arrested on April 18 in connection with an alleged molestation case in Uttar Pradesh’s Muzaffarnagar district.

body.html:
Muzaffarnagar: Aryaman Raghuvanshi (28), son of former state minister Sudhir Kumar Baliyan, and his accomplice Shaurya Gupta (18) were arrested on April 18 in connection with an alleged molestation case in Uttar Pradesh’s Muzaffarnagar district.

The incident reportedly took place on Friday night in the Nai Mandi area. According to police and eyewitness accounts, the accused, allegedly under the influence of alcohol, approached a 24-year-old woman and her mother while they were walking outside their home.

They allegedly used abusive language, made obscene gestures, and physically pushed the victims. The victims recorded the incident on their mobile phones, and CCTV footage from the area also helped police identify the accused.

Based on the complaint, police registered a case under relevant sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), including Section 74 (assault or criminal force with intent to outrage modesty), Section 79 (words or gestures insulting modesty), Section 115 (voluntarily causing hurt), and Section 352 (intentional insult to provoke breach of peace).

Police confirmed that both accused were arrested soon after the incident. However, reports of their quick bail have triggered public concern, with allegations that relatively mild sections and possible political influence may have facilitated their release.

Meanwhile, Sudhir Kumar Baliyan has denied the allegations, claiming they are politically motivated and false.

The case has sparked debate over women’s safety, legal provisions, and the influence of political connections in criminal proceedings.

#Muzaffarnagar #UttarPradesh #MolestationCase #WomenSafety #BreakingNews #BNS

articles.title: “Molestation Accusation Sparks Street Justice!” Youth Beaten, Forced to Apologise in Farrukhabad
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Farrukhabad: A youth accused of molesting a young woman was allegedly beaten by locals and forced to apologise in Uttar Pradesh’s Farrukhabad district. A video of the incident from the Fatehgarh area is now going viral on social media.

body.html:
Farrukhabad: A youth accused of molesting a young woman was allegedly beaten by locals and forced to apologise in Uttar Pradesh’s Farrukhabad district. A video of the incident from the Fatehgarh area is now going viral on social media.

The incident occurred on JNB Road under the Fatehgarh Kotwali area, where the accused was caught by locals after the woman objected to his behaviour. According to reports, the woman beat the youth with slippers, while others present at the scene also thrashed him.

The video shows the accused holding the woman’s feet and begging for forgiveness. Following the apology, locals reportedly let him go.

However, police have presented a slightly different version of events. According to Fatehgarh police, the youth, who is a neighbour of the woman, had stopped her on the road and started talking to her, which she objected to. Upon hearing this, her brother reached the spot. When the youth allegedly began abusing him, the brother assaulted him.

Police said they have taken cognisance of the matter based on the woman’s complaint and are proceeding with further legal action.

The incident has sparked debate over public reactions and handling of such allegations, especially with videos of such confrontations frequently going viral.

#Farrukhabad #UttarPradesh #MolestationCase #ViralVideo #BreakingNews

articles.title: Land Seller Dragged, Assaulted in Broad Daylight Near Police Station in Pilibhit
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Pilibhit: A shocking incident of alleged abduction attempt and assault has surfaced from Puranpur in Uttar Pradesh’s Pilibhit district, where a land seller was forcibly dragged into a car and beaten after a property deal dispute.

body.html:
Pilibhit: A shocking incident of alleged abduction attempt and assault has surfaced from Puranpur in Uttar Pradesh’s Pilibhit district, where a land seller was forcibly dragged into a car and beaten after a property deal dispute.

According to reports, the incident took place near the registry office and the gate of Puranpur Kotwali police station. The seller had reportedly completed a land registry but was not paid around ₹80 lakh–₹90 lakh by the buyer.

When the seller demanded the pending payment, the accused allegedly resorted to violence. He was forcibly dragged into a car, assaulted, and an attempt was made to abduct him. During the struggle, the victim managed to raise an alarm and later jumped out of the vehicle to save his life.

Locals rushed to the spot upon hearing the commotion and rescued the victim, forcing the accused to flee without making the payment.

The accused, reportedly from Haryana, allegedly carried out the act openly near the police station, creating panic in the area. A video of the incident, showing the victim being dragged and beaten, has gone viral on social media.

Police said that based on the complaint received at Puranpur police station, an FIR has been registered under relevant sections. Preliminary investigation suggests the matter is linked to a financial dispute over a land transaction.

Further legal action is underway as police continue to investigate the case.

#Pilibhit #UttarPradesh #LandDispute #CrimeNews #ViralVideo

articles.title: “3 Hours Wait, Then Abuse!” Blood Bank Negligence Alleged in UP Hospital
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Siddharthnagar: Allegations of serious negligence and misconduct have surfaced at the blood bank of Madhav Prasad Tripathi Medical College in Uttar Pradesh’s Siddharthnagar, after a video showing staff allegedly misbehaving with patient attendants went viral on social media.

body.html:
Siddharthnagar: Allegations of serious negligence and misconduct have surfaced at the blood bank of Madhav Prasad Tripathi Medical College in Uttar Pradesh’s Siddharthnagar, after a video showing staff allegedly misbehaving with patient attendants went viral on social media.

According to the attendants, who are residents of Kamariya Buzurg village under Kolhui police station area, they were made to wait for nearly three hours at the blood bank despite the patient requiring urgent blood for surgery.

They alleged that even though a donor was present, the blood was not drawn for hours, causing critical delay in treatment. The attendants claimed that blood was provided only after prolonged waiting.

The situation escalated when the attendants questioned the delay. They alleged that a blood bank employee, identified as Alok Kumar Mishra, verbally abused them and behaved in an insulting manner.

The viral video reportedly captures the staff’s rude behaviour, further intensifying concerns over patient care and accountability in government healthcare facilities.

The incident has raised serious questions about the functioning of the health department and the conduct of medical staff, especially in emergency situations.

Authorities are yet to issue an official statement on the matter.

#Siddharthnagar #UttarPradesh #HealthCare #MedicalNegligence #ViralVideo

articles.title: “Advance Paid, Goods Missing!” Shopkeeper Beaten by 7 Men Over Payment Dispute in Ghaziabad
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Ghaziabad: A shopkeeper was allegedly assaulted by a group of seven men over a payment dispute in Uttar Pradesh’s Ghaziabad on April 14. According to the complaint, Sumit Jain had paid an advance to Arju Ansari for supplying goods through an online deal.

body.html:
Ghaziabad: A shopkeeper was allegedly assaulted by a group of seven men over a payment dispute in Uttar Pradesh’s Ghaziabad on April 14.

According to the complaint, Sumit Jain had paid an advance to Arju Ansari for supplying goods through an online deal. However, the goods were not delivered, and when Jain refused to make the full payment, the accused allegedly confronted him.

Police said Arju Ansari, along with several associates, reached Jain’s shop and began abusing him before brutally assaulting him.

The accused have been identified as Arju Ansari, Imran, Khurshid, Aman Mujjim, Sameer, Sueb and Sanjay.

Following the incident, a case has been registered against all the accused, and police have initiated further investigation into the matter.

The incident highlights rising disputes linked to online transactions and business dealings.

#Ghaziabad #UttarPradesh #AssaultCase #CrimeNews #BreakingNews

articles.title: Son of Ex-BJP Minister Arrested for Molesting Mother-Daughter Duo in Muzaffarnagar
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Muzaffarnagar: Police arrested two youths, including Aryaman Raghuvanshi, son of former BJP minister and ex-MLA Sudhir Baliyan, for allegedly molesting a mother and daughter in the Nai Mandi area here.

body.html:
Muzaffarnagar: Police arrested two youths, including Aryaman Raghuvanshi, son of former BJP minister and ex-MLA Sudhir Baliyan, for allegedly molesting a mother and daughter in the Nai Mandi area here.

The incident occurred late at night on Railway Road when the mother-daughter duo was out for a walk. The accused, reportedly intoxicated, approached them, harassed, and behaved indecently while hurling abuses. The victims were standing outside their home.

The victim filmed the entire incident on her phone. Based on her complaint, a case was registered at Nai Mandi police station under relevant sections of molestation.

The arrested accused are Aryaman Raghuvanshi, resident of Pacheda Road, and his companion Shaurya Gupta, resident of Shivpuri. Both have been taken into custody, and further legal action is underway, said CO Nai Mandi Raju Kumar Sao.

#Muzaffarnagar #BJPMinisterSonArrested

articles.title: “Sleeping Youths Attacked!” Masked Gang Thrashes 3, Loots Cash & Gold on Rajasthan Highway
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Beawar: In a shocking incident from Rajasthan’s Beawar, more than 10 masked attackers brutally assaulted three youths who were sleeping outside a hotel and looted cash and valuables.

body.html:
Beawar: In a shocking incident from Rajasthan’s Beawar, more than 10 masked attackers brutally assaulted three youths who were sleeping outside a hotel and looted cash and valuables. The incident occurred near Khejda Chauraha on the Beawar-Pali Highway under the Saketnagar police station area.

According to police, the attack took place on the night of April 14, though CCTV footage of the incident has surfaced only now. The video shows a group of assailants attacking the youths with sticks, creating panic in the area.

As per the complaint filed by Leela Devi, a resident of Kesarpura, her 22-year-old son Surendra Kathat had stopped near a hotel on the highway while returning to his village from Beawar. He was resting on a cot along with two other youths when the attackers struck.

The FIR states that Sunil and Narendra, residents of Jaitpura, along with Sanjay from Kesarpura and around 10 others, suddenly attacked the youths with sticks. During the assault, the accused allegedly robbed ₹50,000 in cash from Surendra and snatched a gold chain from his neck before fleeing the spot.

Surendra Kathat sustained serious injuries in the attack. Locals rushed him to Amritkaur Hospital in Beawar, where he was treated and later discharged.

CCTV footage from the hotel clearly shows the attackers beating the victims, who are seen trying to escape. One youth is seen falling to the ground and being repeatedly kicked by the assailants.

Police have registered a case against 10 accused, including three named individuals, and have launched an investigation based on CCTV evidence.

#Rajasthan #Beawar #CrimeNews #CCTVFootage #Loot
